data.name: Mahmudiy
data.gender_notes: Mahmudiy is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is praised and glorified, a name of great honor and dignity. The name Mahmudiy carries the meaning “Praiseworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahmudiy usually hope their child will grow to embody praiseworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the person's connection with Allah and their desire to be praised by Him.
data.etymology: Mahmudiy belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiseworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahmudiy total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
